Method of Attack: Exploiting unpatched Pulse Secure VPN servers using CVE-2019-11510 vulnerability to gain unauthorized access
Using ransomware to encrypt data and demand ransom
Propagating malware through interactive prompts on vulnerable VPN interfaces
Discoverer: Scott Gordon (CISSP), Pulse Secure Chief Marketing Officer
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of Pulse Secure VPN servers via specially crafted URIs exploiting CVE-2019-11510
Directory traversal and access to files containing plaintext login credentials
Buffer overflow and command injection vulnerabilities in Pulse Secure appliances
Use of unpatched VPN servers lacking multi-factor authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Exploit code available on Metasploit framework and GitHub
Malicious IP addresses conducting remote logins at odd hours
Unpatched Pulse Secure VPN servers detected (3,328 as of January 2020 scan)
Ransomware ransom demand of $3 million in Travelex attack
